content: There was no sound in the world—only the blinding white flower mirrored in the weeping pupil of the Queen. The mountains, the mud, the bloodied snow: everything was drowned in a sea of immaculate, silent light where time ceased to flow.
critique: Rothfuss: Sublime lyrical beauty and visual perfection.

content: The photon flux exceeded 1.2 megawatts per square meter, yet radiated zero thermal kinetic transfer to organic tissue, operating strictly as an entropy-scouring quantum wave. The atmosphere was wiped clean of all synthetic frequencies.

The Black Sun hung in the sky like an eye that had finally closed after a thousand years of watching cruelty. Beneath it, the white light touched the kneeling soldiers, washing the mud from their brows with the tenderness of rain.
critique: JH: Moving psychological tranquility after cosmic violence.
